propositions: MCP read tools render_workflow and get_workflow_status report caller-input not-found failures with error code llm_unavailable, defeating error-code branching logic

Blanket LLMError to llm_unavailable mapping in error_code_for collapses WorkflowError/WorkflowParseError not-found cases without distinguishing transient backend unavailability from permanent caller mistakes

New WorkflowNotFoundError subclass routes unknown-workflow-name and unknown-run-id failures to not_found code; WorkflowParseError/ValidationError/VersionError route to invalid_input; bare WorkflowError execution errors preserve llm_unavailable for genuine LLM outages
error_code_for classifier logic centralized via _workflow_caller_code helper; _structured_llm_failure now delegates to error_code_for to share single taxonomy across both LLM-tier sites
Vocabulary additions not_found and invalid_input added to KNOWN_ERROR_CODES, schemas/common.schema.json, and docs/mcp-reference.md to honor the structured-failure contract
